title: Redundant "View Grid" options in 3D Workspace OVERRIDE each other
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.6.1.stable, v4.7.beta2 [777579205]

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot v4.7.beta2 [777579205] - DirectX12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA RTX 4060 (8 GB)

### Issue description

In 3D, the "View Grid" option has 2 shortcuts assigned (with the 2nd being blank). The first shortcut is labelled as "**view_grid**", (which controls the "View" menu option), and the second is labelled as "**view_grid_lines**" (which controls the "Perspective" menu option).

- The "View" menu version will toggle **ONLY** the grid.
- The "Perspective" menu version will toggle **BOTH** the grid and the origin axes.

**Unfortunately, there are multiple issues with this system:**

1. If you only change the 1st shortcut (for "View" menu), nothing will happen **until you hover your mouse** over the "View" menu (then Godot wakes up and will toggle your desired state).

2. If "View Grid" is disabled in the "View" menu (either via shortcut or direct toggle), then "View Grid" in the "Perspective" menu will **ONLY** toggle the origin axes, **NOT** the grid (contrary to what the menu name suggests).

3. If you instead change the 2nd shortcut (for "Perspective" menu), then Godot will toggle between enabled and disabled **instantly** upon your key press, this is **correct and expected** behavior.
However, then the following happens:

4. If "View Grid" is disabled in the "Perspective" menu (either via shortcut or direct toggle), then "View Grid" in the "View" menu has **NO effect** at all (contrary to what the menu name suggests). This also means "View Origin" has **NO effect** either, since it too is being overridden by the "View Grid" setting in the Perspective menu.

This buggy behavior can be remedied by **unifying** the "enabled/disabled" states between the two options under a **single shortcut**, and leaving the action of showing/hiding the Origin Axes to the already existing "Show Origin" shortcut.

Thank you for looking into this!

### Steps to reproduce

**SHORTCUT DETECTION CHECKS:**
1. In a blank 3D scene, go to Editor > Editor Settings > Shortcuts and search for "View Grid".
2. Change the first option (for the "View" menu) from "NumberSign" to something like LeftBracket or Kp Divide.
3. Attempt to toggle the grid display via your custom shortcut and observe nothing happens (until you hover your mouse over the "View" menu).
4. Now change the second shortcut option for "View Grid" (which controls the "Perspective" menu setting).
5. Attempt to toggle the grid display via this new shortcut and observe it toggles **as expected.**

**OVERRIDE CHECKS:**
6. Ensure the "View Grid" option is **deselected** in the "**View**" menu, and directly toggle "View Grid" inside the "Perspective" menu. Observe only the origin axes are toggled, **NOT** the grid.
7. Ensure the "View Grid" option is **deselected** in the "**Perspective**" menu, and directly toggle "View Grid" inside the "View" menu. Observe the option does **NOT** work at all (additionally the "View Origin" option does **NOT** work either since it also is being overridden by the "View Grid" setting in the "Perspective" menu).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
